reviews.text: We called on Laura several times for our French Bulldog who has reactivity issues with other dogs. Laura is incredibly attentive to canine behavior and helped us make real progress by implementing various tailored exercises that allowed our dog to make genuine improvements! I highly recommend her professionalism and her excellent follow-up from start to finish.
My dog ​​and I can't stop praising Laura. She helped me a lot in correcting my dog's behavior during the first session. My dog ​​eagerly awaits Laura's two weekly walks.

I contacted Laura for behavioral issues with two cats from my association.

The results are very positive. Laura is gentle, experienced, and above all, very effective. She provides thorough and rigorous follow-up; I recommend her 100%.
A big thank you, Laura, for your invaluable help.
There's no respect within the team. Strong urine odors permeate the street. The animals are locked inside their center and defecate on themselves as they leave the door…

Laura was fantastic! She came directly to my home and complimented me on how I was already training my puppy, while also giving me tips to improve. This kind of interaction with a dog trainer is so important. Thank you, Laura!

An excellent trainer, very attentive and offers great advice.
Our American Staffordshire Terrier had significant difficulties with cars. In just one session, Laura offered us a gentle and effective method to improve his behavior. It worked very well: after a few days, we noticed significant progress.
We recommend her 100%!

We contacted Laura for our French Bulldog, and the experience was very positive. She quickly understood our dog's behavior and clearly explained the areas we needed to work on.

The session took place in a supportive atmosphere, using methods that were respectful of the animal. She gave us concrete and easy-to-implement advice for everyday life.

Our dog was receptive during the session, and we've already seen improvements. It's reassuring to have someone professional who takes the time to explain and adapt to our situation.

I highly recommend her.

Laura is an amazing dog trainer and a wonderful person. She watched my puppy for two nights in her apartment in Paris right after he flew in from the U.S., and I couldn’t have asked for someone more caring. His food hadn’t arrived yet, and Laura actually cooked for him! She brought him to the dog park, took him on walks, and treated him like her own. Every night she sent vlog-style updates so I could see how he was doing, which meant so much—especially since he had just gone through a long trip. I feel lucky to have found her and highly recommend her for anyone who is looking for a trusted trainer, walker or sitter.
Our very wild cat has become adorable after clear and wise advice. We love him even more... and he's so much happier! Thank you, Laura!

A trustworthy person, very attentive to my 5-month-old puppy. Highly professional and punctual. A real pleasure to leave Ad-Hoc with her; he goes on fantastic walks and plays with boundless energy! He's thrilled and loves it. A big thank you, Laura.
Laura is a true professional: attentive to animals and to worried owners. My pet adores her. He's living his best life by her side. I recommend her 100%.
Laura is a professional who listens, teaches well, and is caring. Thanks to her guidance, significant improvements have been made. Thank you so much!

Laura is amazing. She’s been taking care of Daisy for 3 years and there isn’t anyone I’d trust more with our fur baby. She is excellent, professional and clearly loves animals. We are very grateful to have found her.

Laura is the best dog trainer we've ever worked with! Our puppy was pulling on the leash and barking at other dogs. After working with her, we saw a significant improvement within a few weeks. Laura's positive reinforcement methods made training fun and stress-free for both us and our dog.

Fantastic experience with Laura 😊. My dog ​​Ryder (a 5-year-old French Bulldog) has behavioral issues with other dogs. And in just two sessions, the progress he's already made is remarkable. Between the exercises at home (where he's even learned to sit and lie down at his age) and the ones we do out, it's incredibly motivating.

Keep in mind that you need to be consistent with the practice outside of the sessions. The explanations are very clear and demonstrate a perfect command of the subject. I highly recommend Laura 😊

Laura is an excellent behaviorist, passionate about her work, and it shows. My cat immediately felt comfortable with her. I received comprehensive support, and she was very available and accommodating. I saw a fairly rapid improvement in my aggressive cat's behavior after following her recommendations and advice, which I will continue to apply!

I don't even know where to begin, this experience has completely changed our lives!
Our cat was peeing and pooping outside her litter box every single day; it had become unbearable and incredibly stressful. We had tried so many things, without success… until we contacted Laura.

From our very first conversation, she listened to us with kindness, analyzed the situation, and, most importantly, offered us concrete advice tailored to our cat and our lifestyle. We implemented everything she recommended… and literally overnight, not a single accident! A true miracle for us.

But the most incredible thing is the change in our cat's behavior. She used to be very fearful, spending her days hiding under the covers… Now, she plays, comes looking for cuddles, and is much more relaxed. It's like having a brand new cat, thriving and happy 🐾

A huge thank you to Laura for her professionalism, gentleness, attentiveness, and passion for animals. I recommend her 1000% to anyone experiencing difficulties with their cat. You're in very good hands!

Laura took care of my cat Nala while I was away, and I couldn't have asked for better! She visited every day, sent me updates and photos, played with her, and made sure she was well cared for. When I returned, I found Nala in great shape and relaxed. A huge thank you to Laura for her professionalism and attentiveness; I highly recommend her!

Due to my dog's reactivity towards some other dogs, I contacted Laura to work on this issue. Very attentive to both the animal and the human, Laura has a gentle and dedicated approach that allows everyone to progress at their own pace. Thank you, Laura!
Top-notch professional. Attentive and very clear. Real, measurable results!

A huge thank you to Laura for her professionalism and the work she put in place. I contacted her about my cat's repeated episodes of defecating outside the litter box, and she quickly identified the problem and implemented appropriate techniques.
With her expert advice and attentive listening, the "problem" was resolved the same day.

Follow-up appointments are scheduled to monitor the effectiveness of the implemented protocols, allowing for adjustments as needed. I highly recommend her and thank her again!

Rémi

Laura is an exceptional person.
Attentive,
Offers excellent advice, and is very professional.
We've had a cat for 7 years.
Very independent,
Not cuddly, preferring to observe from a distance.
We adopted a kitten.
Laura helped us create a bond between the two cats (it was far from a sure thing).
And thanks to Laura, the two cats are now best friends and follow each other everywhere.
We highly recommend Laura.

I contacted Laura for help with my cat Tao's behavior, and I highly recommend her! She is very professional, patient, and attentive. She quickly understood the situation and gave me simple, effective advice tailored to my daily life.
Thanks to her guidance, I've seen a real improvement in Tao's behavior; he is now much calmer. Her approach is respectful and caring, and she is always available to offer advice. Honestly, a superb experience—I highly recommend her!

Thank you again, Laura!

Laura is very professional, gentle, and reassuring. We were able to leave our dogs with a stranger for the first time with complete confidence; we even managed to forget about them for a few hours! She is very attentive to owners and understanding. I recommend her 100%.
Laura is a very trustworthy and professional person. Excellent communication skills, always attentive and offering sound advice. Thank you.
Very attentive and offers good advice. She takes excellent care of our four-legged companions, all with kindness. Highly recommended.

Laura Monfort is very professional, attentive, and patient. I consulted her in January about a very timid cat who needed eye drops, and she showed me how to do it gently and patiently, making the task much easier. I had previously used her services for help with caging and for home visits while I was away with various cats, and everything always went perfectly. This included my current cats (mine and the one mentioned above), who came out to greet her, eat, and play with her. She is friendly, gentle, and very good with animals. She also listens to people, which is a real plus. I highly recommend her!

A huge thank you to Laura for her efficiency. Fabio, an 18-month-old Bengal cat, was showing signs of panic at the slightest provocation. Thanks to her quick intervention, we were able to improve his behavior and better understand our cat.
Laura is taking wonderful care of Gribouille, our cocker spaniel, whom we're leaving with her for the holidays! His frantic run when he arrives in the street is the best sign!
Laura is an incredible dog sitter for our labrador Fitz. We cant begin to thank her for taking such good care of him!

Laura is very professional and has a great rapport with animals; my dog ​​(a Japanese Spitz) adores her! Laura is also very reliable and sends photos after every walk—everything is perfect! I highly recommend her.

Laura has been our cat sitter for two years now. I highly recommend her. Enthusiastic, responsive, always available, punctual, generous, and very professional... she's perfect for us, and we can go on vacation with complete peace of mind. Thank you, Laura!

Laura is a great professional, kind and attentive, I have absolute trust in her :) Our dog has been staying every Thursday in daycare with Laura, and he was the happiest puppy in the world! She's communicative and very sweet. I recommend 100%.

I contacted Laura because my cat was marking my bed. During the appointment, we talked at length about my cat and our routines, and Laura advised me on some changes to resolve the issue. It was very effective, and since her visit, he hasn't marked my bed at all! I really appreciated her consideration for my cat. I'm absolutely delighted!! I highly recommend her.

Laura takes care of our cats when we have to be away. She's always so attentive that it seems like our cats miss us coming back every time... She sends us updates every day, which allows us to leave with peace of mind.

I would like to express my deepest gratitude for all the care and affection you have given my cat. It is very comforting to know that he was in such safe and loving hands. Your dedication to ensuring he was well-fed, comfortable, and happy during my absence went beyond what I could have hoped for. I am truly grateful for everything you did. Thank you so much!
